__baseline_prompt__.text: Create a documentary performance photograph, a photographic scene from an idol-industry story centered on a fictional idol performer during a visible working moment in idol life. Use the supplied portrait to guide the lead woman's visible facial and hair appearance: a soft oval facial outline, dark eyes, a small nose, softly defined lips, and a chin-length dark bob with wispy separated fringe. Her fictional age is twenty-four. She is on a music-show rehearsal stage just as the floor manager gives her group the count to begin again. The lead has returned to a small taped X on the dark stage floor. Her right hand holds a wireless microphone a few centimeters from her open mouth; her left arm hangs relaxed beside her hip. Her weight rests on the foot centered over the X, with the other heel lightly lifted behind. Her face turns toward the floor manager's raised hand, intent and newly ready, a slight half-smile at one corner of her lips. At the lower right edge of the stage, the floor manager in black rehearsal clothes and a headset faces the performers in three-quarter back view, raising one index finger in a clear count-in. His arm and hand stand apart from the lead's silhouette. Two fellow women in their twenties, wearing related silver-grey cropped stage jackets and dark pleated performance skirts, wait on their own separate floor marks behind the lead in a shallow diagonal formation. The lead wears the same tailored jacket with a pale satin top, skirt and practical ankle boots; a small in-ear monitor sits at her visible ear. White rehearsal work lights reveal the floor marks and the real working space beneath dim violet stage lights. Frame the lead full length at roughly two-thirds of the image height, her face remaining crisp, with the manager's cue hand and both group members visibly connected through their directed attention. A moderate wide lens from the side of the empty studio seating keeps the lead dominant while allowing the stage edge and the preparation to read. Natural skin texture, a trace of exertion at her temple and the relaxed fall of the jacket give her poised presence a quiet, close human appeal.
